sense: The inference from A_j and A_j implies A_i to A_i, not proof by contradiction.
rationale: The English definition explicitly says modus ponens. Its unchanged formula gives A_k as A_j implies A_i and takes A_j and A_k as earlier premises. The previous MSA label names proof by contradiction, a different rule. The Classical translation already uses the descriptive term قاعدة إثبات المقدَّم, so carrying that exact rule name back to the shared MSA source restores the same mathematical referent in all three editions. The Classical syntax and RTL presentation are not propagated.

alternatives.reason: Names proof by contradiction, not the rule explicitly defined by the source and formula.
Can name a broader family of syllogistic inferences; it is less specific than stating affirmation of the antecedent in this definition.
Provides an unambiguous cross-language lookup without leaving the Arabic reader untranslated.

expert_review.question: هل «قاعدة إثبات المقدَّم» هو المصطلح العربي المعتمد للاستدلال من A ومن A يستلزم B إلى B؟ إن كان للمعاجم المنطقية اصطلاح أدق، يرجى اقتراحه مع مرجعه؛ لا يراد هنا البرهان بالخلف.
